title: ClusterLM routing alias, schema v1 (ADR 0402; contract revision v1.1, ADR 0407)
description: Unknown fields are rejected at every level (same policy as profile-v1). Selection semantics: profile-schema-v1.md section 6.

api_model_id.description: Must not collide with any profile or alias api_model_id. 'auto' and 'default' are reserved for aliases.

allow_lan.description: Visible to LAN-authenticated keys. A candidate is still considered only if the candidate profile itself is visible to the calling key (exposure.api, exposure.allow_lan for LAN keys, key allowed_models): an alias never widens access.

policy.description: first-viable: the first candidate (list order) that is viable. best-ready: the first candidate that is already prepared (ready/busy); if none, the first viable one. Both are deterministic for the same inputs.

candidates.description: Evaluated in order; profile_ids are unique. A candidate is viable when its profile is visible to the calling key (see allow_lan), its `when` holds, and its readiness is ready/busy, or loadable when allow_prepare is true and require_ready is false.

workers_available.description: Worker slot names of the candidate profile that must be satisfiable right now (validated: each names a worker slot of that profile).

require_ready.description: true: only if already prepared (never trigger a prepare job).

avoid_on_battery.description: Not viable if any machine the candidate's plan would use (Host included) is on battery.

allow_prepare.description: May a request to this alias start a prepare job of the chosen candidate? Default false: alias only routes among prepared profiles.
